findings.title: `.small-action` button's `float: right` is ignored once the container is flex
findings.body: `.small-action` is now `display: flex`, so its children are flex items and `float` has no effect on them. `button { float: right; }` therefore no longer pushes the button to the right edge. It now sits immediately after `.small-action-desc`, because the desc has no `flex: 1` and the button has no `margin-left: auto`. The same applies to `.topic-avatar { float: left }`, which is now a dead rule. The small-action edit/undo buttons used to be right-aligned, and this change moves them next to the text. Right-align the button explicitly, for example with `margin-left: auto` or a growing desc, and drop the dead float rules.

findings.title: Custom message paragraphs lose all spacing
findings.body: The `.custom-message p` margin changed from `5px 0` to `0`, and `.small-action-desc > p` also lost its `padding-top`. A custom message with several paragraphs now renders them with no gap between them. The surrounding vertical rhythm also shifts: the `margin-top: 5px` and the `0.5em` vertical padding on `.small-action-desc` were removed. This reads as a visual regression that is unrelated to the header work.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin emits invalid legacy declarations for flex-start/flex-end
findings.body: The mixin copies the same `$alignment` value into the legacy `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` properties. Those old syntaxes use `start` and `end` rather than `flex-start` and `flex-end`, so any future `@include align-items(flex-start)` produces invalid declarations for the older engines. `-ms-align-items` is not a real property at all, and line 120 has trailing whitespace. This works for the `center` and `baseline` values used in this PR, but the mixin is a trap for the next caller. Map the values for the legacy properties, or document that only `center` and `baseline` are supported.

findings.title: Unrelated small-action restyle bundled under a header-performance PR with no description
findings.body: The PR title claims to 'optimize header layout performance', and the description is just 'Test 5'. The diff also converts `.small-action` to flexbox and rewrites its paddings and margins, and changes the badge, topic and `.extra-info-wrapper` styles. None of this is explained, and no performance rationale is given. This makes review and bisecting harder, and the small-action change introduces the layout regressions noted above. It should be split out or at least described.
